recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大型組織球，細胞質內塞滿灰藍到黑色、大小不一的顆粒與碎屑，周圍是正常造血前驅細胞，符合吞噬碎屑的組織球（debris-laden histiocyte）。
features: Large histiocyte, several times the diameter of surrounding myeloid precursors, with ill-defined cell borders
Abundant cytoplasm packed with innumerable fine gray-blue granules and coarser dark brown-black globules (ingested cellular debris/pigment)
Histiocyte nucleus largely obscured by overlying cells and inclusions
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes without an obvious blast population
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a trilineage hematopoietic background with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A large histiocyte in the center contains abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous fine gray-blue granules and coarse dark globular inclusions, consistent with phagocytosed cellular debris and possible pigment. No intact phagocytosed hematopoietic cells are evident within this cell, and no organisms are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden histiocyte, a nonspecific marker of increased cell turnover.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytes contain intact or partially digested erythrocytes, platelets or nucleated cells rather than predominantly granular debris.
Sea-blue histiocytes show uniform sea-blue ceroid granules on Wright-Giemsa rather than heterogeneous gray and black debris.
Hemosiderin appears as golden-brown to blue-black granules that are confirmed by Prussian blue staining, which is not provided here.

ddx.dx: Histiocyte containing intracellular organisms (e.g. Histoplasma, Leishmania)
ddx.vs: Organisms are uniform oval bodies with a clear halo or kinetoplast, unlike the variably sized amorphous debris seen here.
